rows.grounds: temporal adverb indicating the moment of revelation described in the preceding verses
compound of saptadaśa and vidyā referring to the seventeenfold mantra-knowledge
adverb emphasizing immediate, unmediated presence or manifestation
compound of jñāna and svarūpiṇī describing the vidyā as having knowledge as its very nature

items.question: What essential nature characterizes the seventeenfold vidyā at the moment of its revelation?
premises: The most essential and well-guarded vidyās were revealed after repeated requests.
At that moment the seventeenfold vidyā was made manifest.
The seventeenfold vidyā is directly of the nature of knowledge.
items.inference: The seventeenfold vidyā revealed at that time is the direct embodiment of knowledge itself.
uncertainties: The exact identity and composition of the seventeenfold vidyā are not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Then the seventeenfold vidyā was revealed as directly knowledge in its very essence.
